completion_gates.coverage_denominator: Dated discovered measurable universe; global coverage remains unknown unless independently established.

primary_document_spot_checks.finding: PT collateral -> borrowed debt asset -> more PT is a separately documented leveraged fixed-yield mechanism. Not every PT pair is supported; current documentation is not T capital evidence.
Smart collateral and smart debt can combine LP fees and credit exposure. A protocol feature does not prove an active material ETH-dollar carry position.
Curve documents ETH-family collateral loans and distinguishes mint-market and lender-funded routes.
Soft liquidation changes collateral exposure over a price range and requires a distinct carry stress treatment.
Official catalogue lists ETH-call and ETH-put contracts on Ethereum/Arbitrum; current activity and material size still require fixed-date investigation.

presentation_conclusion: Suitable to present as selected market mapping and deep case studies with explicit limits; not established as a complete market or maximum-variant carry survey.
revision_note: Corrected on 4 October: the original 15 / $180.413M count was a USD valuation of all loan currencies, including WETH. The original stablecoin-only cohort is seven / $85.049M. Neither amount is confirmed carry capital. New follow-up evidence is separate.
